posts.author: KaranAggarwal
posts.text: Which SIP platform would you recommend for long-term investing: Zerodha Coin, Groww, Kuvera, ICICI Direct or another platform? — For a 20–30-year horizon, I would focus less on the app and more on the underlying structure. Choose a platform offering direct mutual funds, clear ownership records, reliable SIP/redemption processes, responsive support, and a straightforward nominee/inheritance process. Also check how it handles NRIs if you move abroad. Zerodha Coin, Groww, Kuvera, ICICI Direct and ET Money can all be evaluated on these parameters rather than UI or popularity alone.
